description: This file defines the RetrieveThingsResponse class, which represents the response to a RetrieveThings command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from various inputs, serializing/deserializing JSON, and accessing retrieved 'Thing' objects.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response to a RetrieveThings command, encapsulating retrieved 'Thing' objects, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing accessors for response data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of RetrieveThingsResponse from various data inputs, such as JSON strings, JsonArray, lists of Things, and with optional predicates or field selectors.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to deserialize a JSON string or object into a RetrieveThingsResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the default ThingId with a placeholder '_'.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the optional namespace associated with this response.

methods.name: getThings
methods.description: Returns the list of retrieved 'Thing' objects, converting from internal JSON array as needed.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity JSON value from a JsonValue, returning a new response instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer, indicating no specific resource path for the response.
